name: N-Dimensional Gaussian (6DGS/7DGS)
definition: Extends 3DGS through conditional distributions, modeling a joint distribution over spatial and non-spatial dimensions (view/time), then conditioning on the query to obtain a view-specific or time-specific 3D Gaussian for rendering.
summary: N-Dimensional Gaussian extends 3D Gaussian Splatting by modeling joint spatial and non-spatial distributions, enabling continuous view-dependent and temporal effects via cross-covariance terms.
